about:
# Phyz Leveling Addon

A leveling guide addon for **World of Warcraft: Forever**, based on RestedXP
Guides and styled with Blizzard's native window and button templates.

Follow your guide, find your next destination, and use quest items and target
buttons from one window.

[Download the latest release](https://github.com/phyzikalgamer/Phyz-s-Leveling-Addon/releases/latest)
· [Changelog](https://github.com/phyzikalgamer/Phyz-s-Leveling-Addon/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
· [Report an issue](https://github.com/phyzikalgamer/Phyz-s-Leveling-Addon/issues)

## Features

- Step-by-step guide list with a progress bar and zone coordinates where available.
- Native WoW frame, fonts, buttons and scroll controls.
- A highlighted current step and greyed-out completed steps.
- **My step** button to bring the current step back to the top of the list.
- **Check quests** button to mark fully completed quest steps using your character's turned-in quest history. Steps with other unfinished actions remain open.
- Clickable active targets in their own section of the window.
- Active quest-item buttons beside their step, with tooltips and cooldowns.
- RestedXP's waypoint arrow and map/minimap markers.
- Adjustable window size, font size and visibility settings.

## Installation

1. Download **PhyzLeveling-VERSION.zip** from the [latest release](https://github.com/phyzikalgamer/Phyz-s-Leveling-Addon/releases/latest). Use the addon ZIP attached to the release.
2. Close WoW and extract the `PhyzLeveling` folder into:

   ```text
   World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/
   ```

   The final path should be:

   ```text
   Interface/AddOns/PhyzLeveling/PhyzLeveling.toc
   ```

3. In the character-selection AddOns menu, enable **Phyz Leveling Addon** and disable **RestedXP Guides** and **OpenXP**. These addons share internal names and must not run together.
4. Start the game. Right-click the guide header to choose a guide, or click **Settings** to open the menu.

To update, close WoW and replace the existing `PhyzLeveling` folder with the
new release. Your settings and progress are stored separately from the addon files.

## Guides and optional addons

The public download includes RestedXP's bundled guides. For Forever, these
cover early leveling—roughly **levels 1–20/22**—and additional special-purpose
guides. **A complete Forever 1–60 guide pack is not included.**

Personal guide packs are not distributed with this project. Guide imports use
the original importer and retain its account checks. If you have a separately
configured **Phyz Personal Guides** companion, enable it alongside Phyz Leveling.

**Questie is optional.** Phyz uses RestedXP's own navigation by default;
Shortest Path Forever and TomTom are not required. A waypoint arrow does not
mean a continuous route line will appear: world-map lines depend on the guide's
path data, and the minimap uses waypoint markers.

## Controls

| Control | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `/phyz` or `/phyzleveling` | Open addon options. |
| **Settings** | Open the guide and settings menu. |
| **My step** | Align the current step with the top of the list. |
| **Check quests** | Check this guide against quests your character has turned in. |
| Target portrait | Click to target or retarget the displayed NPC or creature. |
| Quest-item icon | Click to use the item associated with that step. |

Separate active-step boxes are hidden by default. You can enable them under
**Guide Window → Show active-step boxes**. The native window styling is available
through the **WoW Classic** theme.

Targeting and item use require a player click. Changes to secure-button layouts
wait until combat ends.

## Help and feedback

This addon is under active development for WoW Forever. If something looks wrong
or a step fails to update, [open an issue](https://github.com/phyzikalgamer/Phyz-s-Leveling-Addon/issues)
with the addon version, guide name, step number, a screenshot and any Lua error.
Do not post personal guide imports or account details.

For development tools and validation instructions, see
[DEVELOPMENT.md](https://github.com/phyzikalgamer/Phyz-s-Leveling-Addon/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md).

## Credits and license

Based on [RestedXP Guides](https://github.com/RestedXP/RXPGuides) v4.11.36 by
RestedXP. Phyz Leveling Addon is not affiliated with or endorsed by RestedXP
or Blizzard Entertainment. Original guide names and author credits are retained.

Distributed under **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**: attribution is required, commercial use is
not permitted, and adaptations must use the same license. Bundled libraries
retain their own licenses. See [LICENSE](https://github.com/phyzikalgamer/Phyz-s-Leveling-Addon/blob/main/PhyzLeveling/LICENSE) and [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/phyzikalgamer/Phyz-s-Leveling-Addon/blob/main/PhyzLeveling/NOTICE.md).

releases.name: Phyz Leveling Addon v0.4.9
releases.notes:
# Changelog

## 0.4.9 — 2026-11-27

- Replace the close X with a minus button that minimizes the guide to a small restore bar, without disabling the addon.
- Reduce footer button labels to 10-point text for additional clearance.
- Replace the crossed map portrait with a quest-scroll icon.

## 0.4.8 — 2026-11-26

- Add Mark as complete and Mark as not complete to the step context menu.
- Remember manual completions per character and guide; exclude completed sticky tasks from active navigation.
- Reopening clears the manual mark and reactivates the task; normal automatic objective checks still apply.

## 0.4.7 — 2026-11-20

- Keep the native innkeeper confirmation dialog available instead of hiding it and clearing the pending interaction. Accept the dialog to bind your Hearthstone.
- Recognize successful manual bindings even with bind automation disabled or Shift held.
- Clarify the bind automation setting: it selects the home option; the player confirms the bind.

## 0.4.6 — 2026-11-18

- My step, the current-step highlight and header counter now prefer the earliest unfinished active task, including sticky steps before the main sequence counter.
- Preserve engine progress and exclude completed or skipped active tasks from this selection.

## 0.4.5 — 2026-11-18

- Align My step using the current calculated row offset rather than stale native screen coordinates after a guide refresh.
- Remove coordinate-based scroll retries; preserve guide progress and the flat row layout.

## 0.4.4 — 2026-11-17

- Avoid reanchoring unchanged guide rows and item buttons during routine refreshes.
- Refresh row text and styling only when their displayed values change.
- Stop unchanged item docking from requesting repeated full guide redraws.
- Disable mouse input on the transparent legacy item container so it cannot intercept world clicks.
- Gameplay smoothness and NPC interaction require confirmation in game.

## 0.4.3 — 2026-11-17

- Anchor guide-list rows directly to the scroll container instead of chaining them to every previous row.
- Reflow row offsets when wrapped text or completion changes their heights.
- Bounds native anchor dependency depth for late-step item buttons; addresses the recursive layout path seen in Error #109 reports.
- Retains current-step scrolling, hidden-row collapse and final-step scroll space. Crash resolution still requires confirmation on the affected client.

## 0.4.2 — 2026-11-17

- Removed full layout rebuilding and duplicate item docking from step-advance hooks.
- Added layout re-entry protection and coalesced resize updates to the next frame.
- Retained lightweight progress updates and native item/target refresh hooks.
- Preventive hardening after an Error #109 freeze report; the report does not identify a confirmed root cause.

## 0.4.1 — 2026-11-17

- Rewrote repository and packaged READMEs for players, covering features, installation, controls, guide availability and support.
- Moved development details out of the main introduction and clarified optional addons and licensing.

## 0.4.0 — 2026-11-17

- Replaced the hand-built frame, portrait rim and corner art with Blizzard's native window template and a basic-template fallback.
- Replaced stretched button textures with real UIPanelButtonTemplate controls while preserving their actions and tooltips.
- Unified header, progress, content and footer spacing; retained completed-step colours, inline item use and docked clickable targets.
- Removed the custom step-corner mask and unused highlight drawing, retaining native grunge and a restrained current-step tint.
- Corrected load-time event handler registration order for Forever.
- Added tests for native templates, fallback, forwarded button actions and event registration order.

## 0.3.5 — 2026-11-17

- Dock active item buttons at the right of their owning step, with text clearance.
- Preserve secure item actions, tooltips and cooldowns; clip icons to the viewport.
- Defer secure layout changes during combat; unmatched actions retain their existing container.

## 0.3.4 — 2026-11-17

- Restored visible native grunge texture in the step panels with brighter texture tints.
- Added a small chamfer mask for clipped panel corners, preserving border-free highlighting.
- Includes v0.3.3's extra right-side scrollbar clearance.

## 0.3.3 — 2026-11-17

- Added 10px of right-side clearance between guide rows and the scrollbar area.

## 0.3.2 — 2026-11-16

- Docked Active Targets in its own section above the footer, preserving secure click-to-target buttons.
- Keep current NPC buttons available after interaction for retargeting; refresh them with guide target updates.
- Show the NPC name for a single target and an empty-state message when none are available.
- Defer docking changes during combat; automatic targeting still requires a player click under the client's secure-action rules.

## 0.3.1 — 2026-11-16

- Centred the round map emblem inside a plain bronze rim, removing the offset tracking artwork.
- Replaced purple scrollbar controls with native WoW arrows and a bronze thumb.
- Restyled the navigation pointer and distance label in gold without changing routing or rotation.

## 0.3.0 — 2026-11-16

- Restyled the guide after the classic profession-window reference: one bronze frame, round map emblem, dark textured body and integrated header/footer.
- Added a green guide-progress strip below the title.
- Replaced footer icons with red-and-gold Settings, My step and Check quests buttons.
- Matched Active Targets to the same bronze and dark-panel styling.
- Preserved guide behaviour, location captions, completed-step colours and border-free current-step highlighting.

## 0.2.12 — 2026-11-15

- Removed the active-step border; retained the background highlight and all other styling.

## 0.2.11 — 2026-11-15

- Replaced the active-step border artwork with a simple one-pixel yellow outline.

## 0.2.10 — 2026-11-15

- Added small zone and coordinate captions from each step's guide waypoint when available.
- Restored softer rounded border artwork while retaining scroll clipping.
- Matched row width to the viewport so both sides of the highlight have equal clearance.

## 0.2.9 — 2026-11-15

- Inset the active-step border and clip child highlights to the guide viewport.

## 0.2.8 — 2026-11-15

- Completed steps use grey text and a darker background, including embedded text colours.
- Current step has a yellow border glow and warm highlight; future steps keep their existing appearance.
- Added a Go to current step footer button to align the active step at the top of the guide viewport.

## 0.2.7 — 2026-11-15

- Added a check button beside Settings to reconcile the current guide with turned-in quests.
- Saves completion per character and guide, with signatures to avoid skipping changed quest instructions.
- Advances past checked quest steps and dims them in the list; retains mixed and unfinished actions.
- Reports newly marked and total checked steps without modifying the quest log.

## 0.2.6 — 2026-11-15

- Align the current step's top edge with the guide viewport when advancing.
- Use actual row positions to avoid scrolling drift with wrapped text.
- Allow the last steps to align at the top as well.

## 0.2.5 — 2026-11-15

- Reduced the quest header icon to 20px and removed its overlapping class badge.
- Reduced the guide title font to 11 and added padding and line spacing in a taller header.

## 0.2.4 — 2026-11-15

- Added a saved “Show active-step boxes” setting under Guide Window, off by default.
- Hiding the boxes leaves the main guide list, step logic and navigation running.
- Re-enabling restores boxes immediately, including after a temporary alpha command.

## 0.2.3 — 2026-11-15
